description:
This file contains cryptography functions implementing various encryption algorithms such as DES, 3DES, RC4, RC2, AES, and others. It provides wrappers around cryptographic primitives, with support for CBC mode and specific encryption methods, including special handling for TLS RC4 encryption.

Functions include generic 'AnscCryptoEncrypt' that dispatches to specific algorithms, as well as individual functions for each cipher. Some algorithms are conditionally compiled based on macros, indicating modular support.

The file appears to be a core component of a cryptographic library within an open source project, providing encryption functionalities to other parts of the system.

methods.name: ULONG AnscCryptoEncrypt(ULONG algorithm,PVOID plain,ULONG size,PVOID cipher,PANSC_CRYPTO_KEY key,PANSC_CRYPTO_IV iv)
methods.description: Performs cryptographic encryption using a specified algorithm, dispatching to the appropriate specific encrypt function based on the algorithm identifier.

methods.name: ULONG AnscCryptoDesIv64Encrypt(PVOID plain,ULONG size,PVOID cipher,PANSC_CRYPTO_KEY key,PANSC_CRYPTO_IV iv)
methods.description: Performs DES encryption in CBC mode with 64-bit IV, updating IV with the last cipher block.

methods.name: ULONG AnscCryptoDesEncrypt(PVOID plain,ULONG size,PVOID cipher,PANSC_CRYPTO_KEY key,PANSC_CRYPTO_IV iv)
methods.description: Performs DES encryption in CBC or ECB mode depending on IV presence, updating IV with the last cipher block in CBC mode.
